description: Models the inference service can load, by id. `config` and `weight` are relative to the pointcept checkout; `classNames` to the repo root. A model's class names travel with it: the head's width is intrinsic to the model, but what index 4 *means* is not, so each entry names its own label space.

litept-scannet20.name: LitePT-small · ScanNet 20
litept-scannet20.description: Fast indoor semantic segmentation, 20 ScanNet classes.

ptv3-s3dis13.name: PTv3 · S3DIS 13
ptv3-s3dis13.description: Point Transformer V3 with relative position encoding, S3DIS 13-class space.

litept-scannet20-random.name: LitePT-small · untrained
litept-scannet20-random.description: Randomly initialised. For checking the plumbing, not the model.
